mechanism.base: Earth gives water its shape, the old texts say. Banks on either side, a bed beneath, and the river goes somewhere instead of everywhere. Without ground to press against, water spreads thin across the land and soaks away into nothing. The bank pushes, and the current answers by running deeper. That pressure turns a flood into a river, and a river into a road that reaches the sea.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Earth, the water has no banks to push against. It spreads wide and shallow and arrives nowhere. Answer to one deadline you did not set, and keep it.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the banks press in until the water barely moves. Every rule you meet turns into a judge of you. Read one slow book before the next demand.

catalyst.clause: the water has no banks to push against
catalyst.remedy: Answer to one deadline you did not set, and keep it.

friction.clause: the banks press in until the water barely moves
friction.remedy: Read one slow book before the next demand.

wide.clause: You were given plenty of Earth, the ground that gives your water a path.
wide.remedy: Use the banks. Take on one hard deadline and meet it.

missing.clause: No bank anywhere, and the water goes wherever the ground tips and settles nowhere.
missing.remedy: Borrow Earth from someone above you, and a date you cannot move.

spared.clause: No Earth presses on the water here, and the current keeps its own depth.
spared.remedy: Leave it absent. Set your own pace and keep it.

thin.clause: Only a little Earth touches the water, a low bank the current clears with ease.
thin.remedy: Keep it that small. Answer to few rules, chosen by you.

excess.clause: Earth piles onto the water until the river chokes on mud and stops moving.
excess.remedy: Clear the mud. Drop two duties, keep one, and rest.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it steady, a rule that stays once you agree. As a catalyst, the standard comes late. You take a dare sooner than a post, and you find your pace after someone sets it.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Earth makes it settled, a frame that stays put. As a friction, the judge becomes you. You measure yourself against every rule as much as every demand and never quite pass your own review.
function.advise_catalyst: You do your best work when someone else sets the deadline. Put yourself under one. Sign up for the race, the exam or the course with a date on it. Tell one person above you what you will deliver and when. Keep one standing rule at home, the same sleep hour every night. Pay one bill the day it arrives.
function.advise_friction: Seek Metal, the Mind energy. Metal is the clear line that sorts a demand into what is asked and what is feared. Let it hold what Earth presses on you. You answer to yourself more strictly than to anyone above you. Ask one person who has done it before, and write down the answer. Then sleep on it.

candidates.cta_verdict: You keep a rule best when you feel its weight rather than read it, and a demand with pressure behind it usually gets your fullest answer.

mechanism.base: The solid prevails over the flowing, and so earth contains water: banks make the river, walls make the well, and depth without a vessel is only weather. Contained, water becomes current, direction, force. The old texts do not call the banks a prison. They call them the reason the river arrives.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing banks you: depth spreading wide and arriving nowhere, freedom without force. Your chart asks for structure. Accept the role, the rhythm, the walls that aim you.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the banks close in: current squeezed into a schedule until the water forgets it moves. Widen the channel. Rivers are meant to breathe.

catalyst.clause: Nothing banks you: depth spreading wide and arriving nowhere, freedom without force.
catalyst.remedy: Accept the role, the rhythm, the walls that aim you.

friction.clause: The banks close in: current squeezed into a schedule until the water forgets it moves.

wide.clause: You are well supplied with Earth, the banks that turn depth into a river.
wide.remedy: Keep the role you have. Let it aim you.

missing.clause: Nothing banks the water: depth spreading wide, arriving nowhere.
missing.remedy: Borrow structure: one role, one rhythm.

spared.clause: Earth runs absent, and the current is free: no banks closing in.

thin.clause: Earth runs thin and unwanted: low banks, easily crossed.

excess.clause: Weak water silts up under strong earth: structure past what the current can move, flow stopped by banks.

function.definition_catalyst: Earth is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the structure that turns your depth into force: fixed roles, steady schedules, commitments that do not move with your moods. You are most creative inside walls you chose.
function.definition_friction: Earth is your Order, and as a friction, it is structure tightening past usefulness: a calendar with no slack, roles held from duty long after they stopped fitting, routine squeezing out the responsiveness you actually run on. Miss one duty and the sternest voice you hear is your own.
function.advise_catalyst: Choose your structure and the rest takes care of itself. Anchor the week with three fixed blocks, same day, same hour, and let everything fluid arrange around them. Accept the role with the schedule. Keep the routine two weeks past the urge to quit.
function.advise_friction: A schedule should hold your life, never replace it. Leave one afternoon a week unscheduled and guard the emptiness. Renegotiate the obligation you dread most. Each quarter, drop one commitment that survives on habit alone.

$original.cta_verdict: Structure is what turns your depth into force, and the steady commitments you resent a little are exactly where your power compounds.
